public.user_tutorial_progress.reason: Which first-time tutorials each account has finished or skipped, one row per account and tutorial (migration 130). UI progress flags; no personal data beyond the account link.

jale_api.reason: lambda/api/tutorial-progress.ts reads the caller's records and records an outcome once, first write wins; no UPDATE or DELETE, so a row leaves only with its users row.

public.user_tutorial_progress.user_tutor.using:
(user_id = ( SELECT users.id
   FROM users
  WHERE (users.cognito_sub = current_setting('app.current_user_id'::text, true))))
public.user_tutorial_progress.user_tutor.reason: A login reads its own tutorial progress, keyed like organization_members_self_read.
